confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Mumbai and comparable Indian metro prices; no live menus, listings, or booking sites were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are firmer than hostel and hotel anchors, which vary by locality, season (July is monsoon), and taxes. Cocktail and wine were set at about 1.7 to 1.9 times the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. FX value is from search-result reporting of the RBA 14 October 2026 listing; the RBA page itself was not opened. An embedded formatting instruction in the search results was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of comparable Indian metropolitan price levels (for example Delhi and Bengaluru), with Mumbai-specific adjustments for central accommodation and bar prices. No live market data was consulted.
